pr.body:
## Problem and result

Production currently runs `2d024921d3c71e1b719bb5fcb9acdb51d250f41b`. The repair carried by #2 remains unmerged. This PR ports its scoped webhook/report/preview fixes onto current main, retaining current Pully branding, command/configuration paths and newer mirror/PR-state behavior.

Refs Proto-UI/Proto-UI#1151 and #2. The original condition is production installation plus authenticated readback; this PR does not claim those operations have happened.

## Changes

- Recover GitHub App deliveries with original GUID/time, scoped installation/repository GETs, bounded resume and no checkpoint advancement for incomplete scans.
- Wait for pending original input; defer fact-free reports; persist canonical input hashes and bilingual editions; reuse existing thread IDs across retries and media failures.
- Restore the normal report-agent path with bounded complete JSON, pagination, citation admission and historical comment cutoffs; distinguish current review context from period evidence.
- Carry bounded read-only inventory / authenticated post verification and explicit historical repair modes. No historical `-apply` operation has been run.
- Preserve Pully/legacy preview compatibility with absent-only fallback, including explicit empty-header rejection.
- Resolve current PR terminal facts **before** input hashing, then feed the same snapshot into one-shot, agent and operator generation. Preserve a corrected edition if the resolver becomes unavailable.

## Source and provenance

Original source remains intact on #2 at `81d1fbcaf5e7c0007348e86ba404d7009a3bc9ae`. The port retains its source attribution in the commit message; original cyjin-yl authorship is not reassigned or re-certified. This Codex contribution is the scoped integration, composition fix and verification.

The original tracking source is `41ef0d32`, `2026-10-11T13:08:00.890Z`, pointer `/data/phases/2/tasks/11`, preserved in Proto-UI's adjacent-source reconciliation record.

## Verification

Isolated Docker environment: Go 1.25.14, Node 20.19.2, two CPUs / 4 GiB; no production database or credential mounts.

- `go test -p 2 ./...` — passed.
- `go vet -p 2 ./...` — passed.
- Both `cmd/proto-pulse` and `cmd/pully-report-repair` build with `-trimpath -buildvcs=false`.
- Negative control: retaining the new public-runner tests while restoring the old hash/generation composition fails both generator modes and the legacy-edition correction assertion. The repaired source passes; the negative control is not a setup/compile failure.
- Current production health/ready, running executable hash, deployment ref, image and active feature flags have been read without mutation.

The root integration reviewer examined recovery, pending-input/hash/cache behavior, original-input scoping, historical JSON boundaries and header precedence. The review then identified the failed-original-input omission documented below; the new revision fixes it. The root reviewer completed an independent final-head review of f66f969d1ce23e8c5455057f42855ae5e0ec53d0, including the full five-file correction and both negative controls, and reported no P0/P1. This is an agent review statement, not a fabricated GitHub APPROVED review.

## Deployment boundaries

Production timers automatically follow main, so merge/deployment must be coordinated. The existing configuration has `PULLY_PROGRESS_AGENT=1`, Pulse enabled and 25-day report lookback; this candidate restores a previously absent agent path and starts original-delivery recovery, so activation has real normal-bot effects.

After independent final-head/gate readback, deploy only to the existing bot repository/channel/configuration with a consistent SQLite backup and prior-image rollback. Verify the running artifact and actual existing reports through authenticated GET-only readback. The live Cloudflare edge is a separate reviewed compatibility deployment. No extra manual Discord message or historical `-apply` is authorized by this PR.

This PR alone does not close Proto-UI/Proto-UI#1151.


## Independent review correction: failed original inputs

The first candidate incorrectly let a delivery become report-ready after its twelfth processing failure. The new revision keeps this as an explicit unavailable-input error and preserves the failed payload across retention. The existing report-repair CLI can inspect one delivery by default; `-retry-delivery ID -apply` explicitly requeues only that failed ID after the cause is fixed. It does not mark the input complete or send a message itself; normal worker success is still required.

A real SQLite/public-runner regression now covers 12 failures with another valid completed fact, zero inference/publication while incomplete, restart and retention, single-ID retry, original GUID/time/payload preservation, successful completion and cached retry. Negative controls separately restore the old failed-input exclusion and old failed-retention rule; each fails the corresponding substantive assertion. Full tests/vet and both builds pass on the repaired candidate. No production retry or historical repair was executed.


## Final review and deployment execution

The independent root review accepted f66f969d1ce23e8c5455057f42855ae5e0ec53d0 after the failed-input correction. The automatic Codex review reported a usage limit; it is retained as unavailable, not represented as passed. Normal merge is attempted with the exact expected head and GitHub server gates; no administrative override is used. Production rollout and GET-only readback are recorded separately after execution.
